title: Joshua's long day (1450 BC high-water event)
summary: The sun stands still over Gibeon during Joshua's conquest; CFAH-19 links the year to the peak of the Ice Age meltdown.
description: The sun stands still over Gibeon during Joshua's conquest; CFAH-19 links the year to the peak of the Ice Age meltdown. Recorded from a CFAH OSF preprint anchor point (not yet published in ARJ). Added by the CFAH pass.

sorting_basis.note: Tier 1: CFAH anchor point: 1450 BC (AP-110, OSF preprint CFAH-19)

chronologies.citation: Griffith & White, "CFAH-19: The Historical Ice Age," OSF preprint v1.0 (8 Jul 2026), doi:10.17605/OSF.IO/A5G6X, file CFAH-19_Historical_Ice_Age_v1.0.pdf, p. 24 ("the year of Joshua’s Conquest, 1450 BC, recorded as new Anchor Point #110")
chronologies.note: CFAH-19 describes it as the high-water mark of the Ice Age meltdown in the year of Joshua's conquest; CFAH-17 p. 21 calls it "Joshua’s Long Day in 1450 BC" (see open question I14).
